command: ghdl --synth --std=08 top.vhd -e top
version: GHDL 6.0.0 (tarball) [Dunoon edition]
exit: 0
--- stderr
--- stdout
library ieee;
use ieee.std_logic_1164.all;
use ieee.numeric_std.all;
entity top is
  port (
    clk: in std_ulogic;
    q: out unsigned (3 downto 0)
  );
end entity;

library ieee;
use ieee.std_logic_1164.all;
use ieee.numeric_std.all;

architecture rtl of top is
  signal wrap_clk: std_logic;
  subtype typ_wrap_q is std_logic_vector (3 downto 0);
  signal wrap_q: typ_wrap_q;
  signal count : std_logic_vector (3 downto 0);
  signal n5 : std_logic_vector (3 downto 0);
  signal n8 : std_logic_vector (3 downto 0) := "0101";
begin
  wrap_clk <= clk;
  q <= unsigned(wrap_q);
  wrap_q <= count;
  -- top.vhd:14:10
  count <= n8; -- (isignal)
  -- top.vhd:19:22
  n5 <= std_logic_vector (unsigned (count) + unsigned'("0001"));
  -- top.vhd:18:5
  process (wrap_clk)
  begin
    if rising_edge (wrap_clk) then
      n8 <= n5;
    end if;
  end process;
end rtl;
